metadata.name: Level Trading - Single ORDER_BLOCK Analyzer (DEBUG)
metadata.description: Single analyzer test to verify Order Block calibration. Entry threshold lowered to 40% to allow more signal participation.
metadata.author: Edison Trading Bot

ORDER_BLOCK_ANALYZER_NEW._comment: Calibration parameters (Session 106): All 10 constants now configurable
ORDER_BLOCK_ANALYZER_NEW._baseConfidence_comment: Baseline confidence for weak blocks (default: 0.15, range: 0.1-0.3)
ORDER_BLOCK_ANALYZER_NEW._confidenceMultiplier_comment: Confidence multiplier for strong blocks (default: 0.8, range: 0.5-0.9)
ORDER_BLOCK_ANALYZER_NEW._recentWindow_comment: Recent candles to check for rejections (default: 10, range: 5-20)
ORDER_BLOCK_ANALYZER_NEW._wickRatioThreshold_comment: Min wick-to-body ratio for rejection (default: 1.5, range: 1.0-3.0)
ORDER_BLOCK_ANALYZER_NEW._maxDistanceThreshold_comment: Max distance for full strength (default: 0.05=5%, range: 0.01-0.1)
ORDER_BLOCK_ANALYZER_NEW._maxRejectionCount_comment: Rejection count for max strength (default: 5, range: 2-10)
ORDER_BLOCK_ANALYZER_NEW._maxDistanceForRelevance_comment: Max distance for block relevance (default: 0.1=10%, range: 0.05-0.2)

notes: DEBUG: Single ORDER_BLOCK analyzer for calibration validation. All filters disabled.
